A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same CTEG/EmoAva research work and complete 19-page documents, including Appendices A–E. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison establish that the manuscript content matches, with only the first-page arXiv version/date stamp differing visibly.

before.justification: v2 reports original quantitative evaluations, human preference results, ablations, and qualitative examples in Section 6 and Appendices C and E, including experiments on EmoAva and the LM-Listener dataset.

after.justification: v3 retains the same original model evaluations, human preference results, ablations, and appendix experiments. These remain original empirical results of the work.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the identical CTEG architecture, Expression-wise Attention, Latent Temporal Attention, variational decoder, target-guided loss, and training and inference procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use EmoAva and the Ng et al. (2023) listener dataset. The data sources, English-language coverage, and speaker/listener expression-generation tasks are unchanged.

E2.justification: LM-Listener, Shuffle, and Random retain the same participation in their corresponding comparisons in Table 2, Figure 4, and Appendix Table 5. No comparator is added, removed, or revised.

E3.justification: The EmoAva split of 12,000/1,500/1,500 instances, 100-epoch training, generation-length settings, evaluation metrics, and human evaluation using 50 sentences and five participants are unchanged. Appendix protocols also match.

E4.justification: The component ablations, KL and latent-cluster analyses, projection-sharing, pooling, BERT fine-tuning, decoder-depth experiments, and qualitative case studies are identical in Section 6 and Appendices C and E.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same uncertainty practices, including bootstrap standard errors using 1,000 resamples in Tables 2 and 6. The descriptions of different random seeds for qualitative generations also match.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plotted trends, and qualitative findings match. For example, Table 2 retains CTEG's Cppl of 262.19 and Diversity of 8.18 at MSL=256; Appendix Table 5 retains L2 values of 0.37 for CTEG and 0.43 for LM-Listener.

T1.justification: The probabilistic formulation, Gaussian assumptions, loss definitions, and Appendix D metric formulations are unchanged. Equations (1)–(18) match between versions.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about end-to-end continuous-latent expression generation, the 15,000-instance EmoAva dataset, and improvements in diversity, fluidity, and emotional consistency.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations and experimental interpretations in Section 6 and Appendices C and E are unchanged. Both retain the same limitations concerning English-only coverage and lack of personalized expression modeling.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, preprocessing instructions, single-A100 hardware disclosure, and dataset licensing and release statements match. The embedded repository link has the same target in both PDFs.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix B, and the bibliography are identical. The cited works and positioning relative to speech-driven avatars, text-driven motion generation, and existing datasets do not change.

P1.justification: The first-page marginal stamp changes from arXiv v2 dated 20 May 2025 to v3 dated 31 Jul 2025. Manuscript wording, terminology, author text, and section and appendix structure are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: All 12 figures, six tables, captions, axes, legends, and page arrangements are unchanged. Rendered pages match exactly outside the updated first-page marginal stamp.

improvement.justification: v3 preserves v2's scientific content, empirical evidence, explanations, reproducibility information, and presentation throughout the main text and appendices. The updated arXiv stamp, added paper self-link, and PDF metadata do not materially improve or diminish the paper's overall quality.
